description:
Named by fz-go4.18.28.10's removable-code audit (2026-07-02, at 2c057aca3). That commit moved owning-symbol extraction to TransportPosition::executable (src/compiler2/transport.rs:285) and deleted jobs/artifact.rs's transport_position_executable helper -- but jobs/transport.rs:1140 (executable_key_for_transport_position) still hand-rolls the identical 7-arm owning-symbol match, and test-file copies exist at transport_contract_test.rs:3712/4898. Left untouched by .28.10 only because jobs/transport.rs was sibling-owned that round (scope discipline, not a judgment that the duplication is fine).

TASK: route jobs/transport.rs:1140 and the two test-file copies through TransportPosition::executable. Pure mechanical unification; watch only that executable_key_for_transport_position may layer extra conversion (symbol -> ExecutableKey) on top of the extraction -- keep that layering, replace just the match. Also sweep for any other hand-rolled copies (rg for the 7-variant match shape). Ride-along: pull.rs:689's doc comment says 'replacing the per-production filter-scan' -- migration narration in a permanent doc; rephrase to present-tense fact.

ACCEPTANCE: one owning-symbol extraction in the codebase; rg shows no duplicate match; suite green 3x; clippy/fmt clean.
title: Unify the hand-rolled owning-symbol matches onto TransportPosition::executable
